messages:
Maya: Quick sync 10s. Need a compact benchmark narrative for next Wed webinar: latency vs token economics across 3 customer workloads. Deliver: 1 one-pager + 3 visuals + 2 social variants + routing spec. Who owns what?
Diego: Ill pull the data and output CSVs. Suggested visuals: 1) latency waterfall (P50/P95) by model variant; 2) tokens->$ Sankey showing batching + prefix cache savings; 3) tiny decision tree for routing by SLO & cost.
Priya: Messaging: no "fastest" claims. Angle: "predictable inference economics" + "safe fallbacks under load." Hero line candidate: "Keep token costs predictable while meeting latency SLOs." Use "up to" ranges.
Noor: Ill mock the slide (horizontal triptych) and social crops. Palette: teal + charcoal, amber for tail. Will annotate Sankey calc.
Caleb: Routing: SMB -> trial; Mid-market -> webinar + playbook; Enterprise -> demo + privacy brief. UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_quickstrike&utm_seg={seg}. Rule: if intent_score >= 70 and api_key_created -> AE queue.
Maya: Two social tones: engineer short + exec ROI. 20-word reg blurb needed.
Priya: Engineer: "See one API keep latency predictable while trimming token spend  Wed 11am PT. Register:" Exec: "Benchmarks + playbook to cut inference spend while protecting SLAs. Live demo." 20-word blurb: "Benchmarks and tactics to reduce inference spend while preserving latency SLOs  real workloads, routing playbook, actionables."
Diego: CSVs + methodology appendix by EOD today. Will label rows by workload.
Noor: Figma link by tomorrow AM.
Maya: Timeline: Diego=data EOD, Noor=mocks tomorrow AM, Priya=copy tomorrow EOD, Caleb=routing doc Friday. I'll assemble one-pager Friday for review. Owners assigned. Thanks! :rocket:
